name: Dungeons & Furries
source:
What's more alluring than the charm of fantasy worlds? Answer: the same, but with sex. So much sex and magic. Swords and witchcraft , dungeons, dragons and breathtaking intimate adventures. What more can one wish for? After all, fantasy can make the boldest and wettest of dreams come true.

And most importantly — all our stories do indeed have a happy… ending! The war between vampires and werewolves is destined to come to a close resolution. The hero squad, with their supplied and favourite dice, will depart for the dungeons and meet a much... warmer welcome than they expected. The dragon, the princess and the knight will see they have nothing to fight over — and it's time to start sharing. And the fairies of the magic forest set their sights on a solitary explorer, ready to do anything to make him stay.

So don your cloaks and armour, pick your weapons — and begin the quest for love and adventure! Don't worry, we already rolled a Critical Success for you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2953170/]Steam[/url]]
